title: Design: Asset tab toolbar stays on one line at 1600 with a search
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1600 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new asset for this test with work orders for two customers whose numbers share a start (for example two work orders whose numbers both begin with the same five characters).
  • Start on the asset's Work Orders tab.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p7-07-after-1600-wide-search-s2-16.png, bt-p7-06-before-1600-wide-search-s2-16.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps: 1. Type the shared start in the tab's Search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work orders of both customers that match are listed.
  • Search box, Status, Customer chip and New sit on one line; nothing wraps.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12316 (Story 14, Asset Work Orders tab: whole history and Customer filter)

  • S14-R1: “The tab lists every service work order on the asset at the current location, for every customer, in today's sort.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
